name: [Ψ]Stop Concentrating
description:
End your concentration on all of your maintained powers.

Channeling this power <color_green>always succeeds</color>.
message: You stop concentrating on your powers.

name: [Ψ]Stop Concentrating (Individual)
description:
End your concentration on a specific power.

Channeling this power <color_green>always succeeds</color>.
message: You stop concentrating on one of your powers.
